en: AI helped us build. We chose what mattered.
zh: AI让想法落地，判断让作品成立。
en_script:
You have seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I will now explain how we built it, and how we could turn it into a sustainable cultural product.

We used Lovable to exchange ideas, Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.
We brought the work together locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.
The game on the right grew out of that process.

The tools helped us build faster. We still had to choose the stories, check their historical order, and make each decision clear.
That work shapes what players take away from the game.
Our business plan begins with the same responsibility: give people an experience worth their time.
That is where our competitive position starts.
zh_script: 大家已经看到了文明航程玩起来是什么样子。接下来介绍我们如何把它做出来，以及如何让它成为可以持续发展的文化产品。我们用Lovable交流想法，Claude做设计，Codex处理API，Grok完成前端和3D场景；在本机整合、测试互动并更新桌面应用。右侧游戏就是这个过程的成果。工具让制作更快，但故事怎样选、历史顺序怎样核对、选择怎样让玩家看懂，仍由我们负责。这些工作决定玩家能从游戏中带走什么。商业计划也从同一个责任开始：提供值得人们花时间的体验。我们的竞争定位由此出发。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 面向观众，承接前面的游戏演示。开场平稳，不急着读流程。
rehearsal.en:
You have seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I will now explain how we built it, and how we could turn it into a sustainable cultural product.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧制作流程；说完工具分工，再指右侧游戏画面。
rehearsal.en:
We used Lovable to exchange ideas, Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.
We brought the work together locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.
The game on the right grew out of that process.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 稍停顿，语气从制作转向自己的判断；最后一句切第二页。
rehearsal.en:
The tools helped us build faster. We still had to choose the stories, check their historical order, and make each decision clear.
That work shapes what players take away from the game.
Our business plan begins with the same responsibility: give people an experience worth their time.
That is where our competitive position starts.

zh: 对标竞品，明确我们的优势
en_script:
Discovery Tour offers detailed historical worlds.
Minecraft Education offers flexible tools for classroom learning.
Both set strong benchmarks. Our focus is a connected cultural journey.

Across four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes, we connect Chinese and world histories through technology and everyday life.
Each route follows a historical sequence. Players make choices whose effects continue into the next chapter.
Imagine sharing supplies with a village. Your ship has less to carry on with, but that village may help you later.
The player now has a personal reason to care about what happens next.

That is our position:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
It gives us a clear experience to build on, while its learning value still needs testing.
The next step is to turn that experience into something customers have a reason to buy.
zh_script: Discovery Tour提供细致的历史世界，Minecraft Education提供灵活的课堂工具，两者都是很好的对标。我们聚焦一段连贯的文化航程：四个时代、八条航线、二十四个场景，以技术和日常生活连接中国与世界历史。每条航线遵循历史顺序，选择的影响延续到下一章。想象玩家把补给分享给村庄，自己的船可用的资源少了，但村庄可能在后面给予帮助。这让玩家有了亲自关心后续故事的理由。定位就是：一段航程、连贯选择、持续后果。这是可以继续建设的体验，学习价值仍需测试。下一步，是让这种体验成为客户有理由购买的产品。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左栏与中栏，各用一句说明竞品长处；随后把重心转向右栏。
rehearsal.en:
Discovery Tour offers detailed historical worlds.
Minecraft Education offers flexible tools for classroom learning.
Both set strong benchmarks. Our focus is a connected cultural journey.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右栏四时代、八航线、24场景；讲村庄例子时看向观众。
rehearsal.en:
Across four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes, we connect Chinese and world histories through technology and everyday life.
Each route follows a historical sequence. Players make choices whose effects continue into the next chapter.
Imagine sharing supplies with a village. Your ship has less to carry on with, but that village may help you later.
The player now has a personal reason to care about what happens next.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指底部总结，三句话之间停半拍；结尾接第三页。
rehearsal.en:
That is our position:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
It gives us a clear experience to build on, while its learning value still needs testing.
The next step is to turn that experience into something customers have a reason to buy.

en: One core experience. Three reasons to pay.
zh: 共同的内容基础，三种付费理由。
en_script:
Start with the player on the left.
For a proposed sixty-eight yuan, they buy the full adventure: a world to explore, people to meet, and decisions that matter.
They will judge us by the experience. Enjoying that first voyage gives them a reason to buy a future story pack.
Our consumer business would grow by earning that next purchase.

The teacher in the middle has a different need.
A good game still takes work to use in class. The teacher needs a lesson they can lead.
Our proposed service costs twelve thousand yuan per institution each year, including discussion guides, two training sessions, and support within an agreed scope.
An industrial story could become a discussion about who benefits from a machine and who bears its costs.
Repeated classroom use would give the institution a reason to renew.

The museum on the right wants visitors to connect with a local story.
Our proposed sixty-thousand-yuan project covers one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
These are test prices; the education and museum offers are still proposals.
Across all three, we would reuse the research and game systems, then charge for the adaptation each customer needs.
That helps each project contribute to the next one.
To see whether it can work, we have to follow the money beyond the sale.
zh_script: 先看左侧玩家。拟价68元，购买的是完整冒险：可以探索的世界、可以遇见的人，以及有影响的决定。玩家会用体验判断我们。第一段航程玩得好，才有理由买未来故事包；消费者业务靠赢得下一次购买来发展。中间教师的需要不同：好游戏要进课堂，仍需要准备，教师需要自己可以带领的课程。拟议机构年费1.2万元，含讨论指南、两次培训和约定范围的支持。工业故事可转成讨论：机器进步让谁受益、谁承担成本。反复课堂使用才是续费理由。右侧博物馆希望观众与本地故事产生联系，拟议6万元项目费包括一主题、三场景、两轮审读。价格仍需测试，教育和文博仍是提案。三类业务共同复用研究和游戏系统，再对各客户需要的适配收费，让一个项目为下一个项目留下积累。要判断这能否成立，还要继续看销售之后的钱去了哪里。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧游戏画面与薄荷绿¥68；像介绍真实顾客的需要一样讲。
rehearsal.en:
Start with the player on the left.
For a proposed sixty-eight yuan, they buy the full adventure: a world to explore, people to meet, and decisions that matter.
They will judge us by the experience. Enjoying that first voyage gives them a reason to buy a future story pack.
Our consumer business would grow by earning that next purchase.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指中间教学概念图与¥12,000；把自己放在教师的处境。
rehearsal.en:
The teacher in the middle has a different need.
A good game still takes work to use in class. The teacher needs a lesson they can lead.
Our proposed service costs twelve thousand yuan per institution each year, including discussion guides, two training sessions, and support within an agreed scope.
An industrial story could become a discussion about who benefits from a machine and who bears its costs.
Repeated classroom use would give the institution a reason to renew.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧文博概念图与¥60,000；介绍完后手势涵盖三栏。
rehearsal.en:
The museum on the right wants visitors to connect with a local story.
Our proposed sixty-thousand-yuan project covers one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
These are test prices; the education and museum offers are still proposals.
Across all three, we would reuse the research and game systems, then charge for the adaptation each customer needs.
That helps each project contribute to the next one.
To see whether it can work, we have to follow the money beyond the sale.

en: Growth must pay for the work behind it
zh: 增长，要能承担持续创作的成本。
en_script:
Our base case assumes two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects in one year.
That brings in three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan—the blue bar on the left.
This is a planning scenario. We have not yet made these sales.

Now follow the chart.
After delivery and customer acquisition costs, the green bar leaves one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
Fixed investment then takes another two hundred and forty thousand yuan.
The final red bar is a loss of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.

We included that loss because it changes our decisions.
Every museum project needs a clear scope. Every teaching package needs to be usable again. Every new player must cost us a reasonable amount to reach.
A larger order creates value only when we can deliver it and keep enough to fund the next story.
So we would measure what each sale leaves behind, together with repeat purchases and renewals.
That leads directly to how we would invest.
zh_script: 基准情况假设一年有两千名付费玩家、十家机构、两个文博项目，带来37.6万元收入，对应左侧蓝柱。这是规划情景，销售尚未实现。沿图往下，扣除交付和获客成本，绿色剩16.08万元；固定投入再扣24万元，红柱最终亏损7.92万元。我们把亏损放进来，是因为它会改变决策：每个文博项目需要明确范围，每套教学材料需要可以反复使用，每位玩家的触达成本要在可承担范围。大订单只有在能够交付、并留下足够资金支持下个故事时才创造价值。所以我们会同时测量每笔销售留下多少、复购和续费如何。这直接决定资金怎样投。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指顶部客户数量和左侧蓝柱。数字放慢，只突出关键金额。
rehearsal.en:
Our base case assumes two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects in one year.
That brings in three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan—the blue bar on the left.
This is a planning scenario. We have not yet made these sales.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 沿图从左向右指橙色、绿色、橙色、红色；红柱处停一秒。
rehearsal.en:
Now follow the chart.
After delivery and customer acquisition costs, the green bar leaves one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
Fixed investment then takes another two hundred and forty thousand yuan.
The final red bar is a loss of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 从图表转向观众；语气坚定，说明数字怎样改变行动。
rehearsal.en:
We included that loss because it changes our decisions.
Every museum project needs a clear scope. Every teaching package needs to be usable again. Every new player must cost us a reasonable amount to reach.
A larger order creates value only when we can deliver it and keep enough to fund the next story.
So we would measure what each sale leaves behind, together with repeat purchases and renewals.
That leads directly to how we would invest.

zh: 让人愿意再来，让故事能够继续。
en_script:
Our proposed funding plan totals three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
The bars on the left cover fixed work, cash for delivery while we wait for payment, and a reserve.
That delivery cash is a timing buffer; it is separate from the operating loss we just discussed.
We would start with one hundred and twenty thousand yuan.

The steps on the right put that money to work.
First, see whether players finish a voyage and choose to return.
Next, test paid offers with educators and museums, and measure the cost of serving them.
Then, use those results to decide whether to release more funding and add new stories.

Over time, each project should leave reusable content, better knowledge of our customers, and stronger partnerships.
A business built that way gives the team room to keep creating.
And that brings us back to the purpose of the voyage.
zh_script: 拟议资金规划共36万元。左侧分为固定工作、等待客户付款期间的交付现金和储备。交付现金是周转缓冲，和上一页经营亏损是两回事。先投入12万元。右侧顺序决定如何使用：先看玩家是否完成航程并主动回来；再向教育者和博物馆测试付费方案，测量服务成本；然后依据结果决定是否释放更多资金、增加故事。每个项目都应该留下可复用内容、更好的客户认知和更稳固的伙伴关系。这样经营，才给团队持续创作的空间。最后回到文明航程为什么出发。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧36万元，再指三根资金分配条和首期12万元。
rehearsal.en:
Our proposed funding plan totals three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
The bars on the left cover fixed work, cash for delivery while we wait for payment, and a reserve.
That delivery cash is a timing buffer; it is separate from the operating loss we just discussed.
We would start with one hundred and twenty thousand yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 沿右侧三个阶段往下，讲清每一步对后续投入的作用。
rehearsal.en:
The steps on the right put that money to work.
First, see whether players finish a voyage and choose to return.
Next, test paid offers with educators and museums, and measure the cost of serving them.
Then, use those results to decide whether to release more funding and add new stories.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 面向观众，语气温和收回整场主题；最后一句切到神殿画面。
rehearsal.en:
Over time, each project should leave reusable content, better knowledge of our customers, and stronger partnerships.
A business built that way gives the team room to keep creating.
And that brings us back to the purpose of the voyage.

en_script:
Look at the ship one last time.
It carries us from Chinese civilization into the wider world, through centuries of invention and change.
Along the way, every new tool changes what people can do. Every choice reveals what they value.
That is the heart of Civilization Voyage.
Our business plan has a purpose too: to give these stories a future, one that people choose to support.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let us choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
zh_script: 最后再看一眼这艘船。它从中华文明驶向更广阔的世界，穿过几个世纪的发明与变迁。一路上，每种新工具都改变人们能够做什么，每次选择都表明人们珍视什么。这就是文明航程的核心。商业计划也有它的目的：让这些故事拥有一个人们愿意支持的未来。我们可以造出更快的船。驶向何方，仍由我们选择。愿我们驶向的未来，值得抵达。谢谢。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 切到神殿与航船全屏画面，先停一秒。后半段抬头看观众，不再指图。
rehearsal.en:
Look at the ship one last time.
It carries us from Chinese civilization into the wider world, through centuries of invention and change.
Along the way, every new tool changes what people can do. Every choice reveals what they value.
That is the heart of Civilization Voyage.
Our business plan has a purpose too: to give these stories a future, one that people choose to support.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let us choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
